seo.title: Hire an agency to set up Steps AI | Steps AI
seo.description: Want help setting up your AI agent? We can introduce you to a Steps AI partner agency that sets up and manages it for you.

hero.title: Get help setting up your AI agent.
hero.body: Steps AI is built to set up without code. If you would rather hand it to someone, we can introduce you to a partner agency that sets up and runs your agent for you.
hero.reassurance: Introductions by our team. Agencies that know the product. You stay the owner of your account.

sections.title: What an agency can do for you.

items.title: Prepare your knowledge
items.body: Tidy your help pages, FAQs and documents so the agent answers well from day one.

items.title: Connect your channels and tools
items.body: Set up WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, your website and integrations such as Shopify.

items.title: Build your workflows
items.body: Switch on and adjust follow-ups such as abandoned cart and COD confirmation.

sections.title: How to get started.
paragraphs: Book a call and tell us what you need. We will suggest a partner agency that fits your business and budget.
Agencies set their own fees, separate from your Steps AI plan.

cta.title: Find an agency for your setup.
cta.body: Book a call and we will introduce you to a partner that fits your business.
